contract: Graph entity label, labels, and internal-ID accessors work for labeled and polymorphic matches.
Global and grouped aggregates preserve DISTINCT, NULL, empty-input, result-type, and arithmetic semantics.
Node and relationship all-property projection expands schema-order properties without losing adjacent expressions.
Relationship-group endpoint-pair ALTER operations validate table kind, report stable errors, and gate later relationship creation.
CREATE property assignment applies supported integer-width, unsigned, and floating coercions.
Focused regressions enforce current intentional Koko decisions and inherited compatibility fixes without reproducing reference crashes or wrong values.
Integer-width casts, arithmetic, negation, modulo, overflow, and cast syntax preserve typed semantics.
Integer, string, float, UUID, BLOB, nested-NULL, and date/timestamp casts preserve exact success and categorized failure behavior.
Numeric-string, boolean, UINT128, UUID, and decimal casts preserve accepted forms, range checks, result types, and exact diagnostics.
Containers retain complete node and relationship values; collect handles DISTINCT, NULL, UNWIND, and identity without ID inflation.
Table comments can be set, overwritten, diagnosed, and observed through catalog introspection.
Statistics-based join anchoring chooses selective scans without changing query results.
Node creation, primary-key enforcement, NULL properties, whole-node rendering, RETURN star, and multi-create execute end to end.
Bundled CSV datasets load typed nodes and relationships with PK endpoint resolution, filtering, aggregation, and traversal.
Node and relationship CTAS publish inferred schema and rows atomically while enforcing PK and duplicate-table rules.
Node/relationship table creation, namespace checks, endpoint validation, drop dependencies, and ALTER property/table operations preserve catalog invariants.
Decimal casts, rounding, formatting, precision/scale propagation, arithmetic, overflow, absolute value, and comparison remain exact.
Lifted correlated EXISTS, COUNT, and OPTIONAL plans preserve activation, NULL extension, multiplicity, and nested correlation.
Constant, computed, nextval, and serial defaults behave correctly on CREATE and ALTER backfill with sequence ownership and errors.
SET, DELETE, DETACH DELETE, relationship creation, write composition, transaction visibility, and empty-database behavior remain safe.
Directed and reverse relationship expansion, relationship values, relationship creation, and two-hop paths execute correctly.
Fan-out factorization preserves logical aggregate multiplicity without materializing unused suffix values.
WHERE evaluates comparison, boolean, arithmetic, NULL, and inline-pattern-property predicates correctly.
Simple and searched CASE expressions preserve NULL matching, branch coercion, and row-dependent evaluation.
Collect aggregates preserve input order, DISTINCT behavior, nested values, and empty-list results over zero non-NULL values.
Date naming/parts, timestamp construction, epoch conversion, truncation, and interval constructors operate over typed stored values.
List lambda transform/filter/reduce, list comprehensions, nested shadowing, and outer-row capture preserve lexical scope and typed results.
Range, list membership, position, slicing, indexing, and nested stored-list access preserve list semantics.
Math, trigonometric, logarithmic, NULL utility, variadic numeric extrema, type inspection, and cast aliases preserve values and formatting.
Regular-expression full/partial match, extraction, splitting, replacement, and literal replacement edge cases remain stable.
Unicode-aware string case, reverse, size, trim, prefix/suffix, substring, indexing, slicing, padding, and edit-distance functions remain stable.
Struct literals/field access and map construction/extraction preserve ordered nested values and key lookup.
Date, timestamp, and interval arithmetic, division, construction, parts, and month/day boundary behavior remain exact.
List signatures/errors, array aliases, common-type coercion, UINT64 overflow, and nested string casts preserve their Koko contracts.
Numeric, string, list, date, map, and CASE functions preserve typed behavior over literals and a bundled typed graph dataset.
K-core decomposition preserves undirected peeling, mixed coreness, parallel-edge and self-loop multiplicity, multi-table selection, named outputs, MVCC visibility, and binder validation.
Serial unweighted Louvain covers canonical communities, CSR self-loop/parallel accounting, deterministic ties, configured limits, multi-table order, composition, MVCC visibility, and validation.

PageRank covers directed CSR pull updates, dangling redistribution, multiplicity/self-loops, typed defaults/options, iteration and convergence boundaries, worker-invariant composition, caller table order, MVCC visibility, and validation.

Directed strongly connected components cover empty, isolated, chunked, chain, cycle, SCC-DAG, self-loop, parallel-edge, disconnected multi-table, canonical-ID, composable YIELD, MVCC-visible, and graph-selection validation contracts.

Statement-bound WCC streams selected endpoints as undirected union-find input and covers deterministic compact IDs, empty/isolated/disconnected, self-loop/parallel, relationship-group, composable YIELD, MVCC, and validation contracts.

Statement-bound directed topological levels cover empty, isolated, layered, disconnected, parallel-edge, multi-table, cyclic, composable, name-selected output, worker-invariant, MVCC-visible, and validation contracts.
Both-side value equality lowers to a hash join while preserving NULL and residual-predicate semantics.
Quoted identifiers, inline primary keys, UUID primary keys, and in-case comment parsing remain accepted together.
Primary-key equality and disconnected-filter pushdown use correct point lookups for integer and string keys.
Sequence, table, macro, and table-info introspection publish filterable, ordered, transaction-coherent schemas and overload rows.
Koko list comprehensions implement optional filtering/projection, NULL input, outer capture, lexical shadowing, and scope/type validation.
Scalar macro definition, default/positional expansion, nesting, property arguments, visibility, drop, and transaction publication remain correct.
MERGE matches or creates nodes and relationships with endpoint-aware keys, multi-element composition, mutation visibility, and all-match updates.
A relationship table routes creation and matching across every declared endpoint-table pair.
CSV loading and querying preserve nested LIST column values and NULLs.
UNION, MAP, and STRUCT values recast recursively across numeric and string child types while preserving field order and NULLs.
Casts to nested unsigned lists preserve empty lists, NULL lists, NULL elements, and large values.
Unlabeled and multi-label node patterns preserve runtime table identity, shared-property access, ordering, and aggregation.
Sequence effects, NULL extension, subqueries, value materialization, and writes block unsafe pushdown, pruning, and factorization.
Projection pruning retains every property needed by filters, ordering, joins, graph values, and later query parts while removing dead columns.
OPTIONAL MATCH preserves left rows, NULL-extends unmatched variables, and composes through WITH.
Optional polymorphic self-loop matching never narrows the outer node scan and NULL-extends missing edges.
ORDER BY, SKIP, LIMIT, and disconnected cross products preserve defined ordering and cardinality.
Morsel parallel scans, projections, aggregates, ordering, limits, and extensions equal serial results across vector boundaries.
Runner-supplied Cypher parameters persist within a case, bind with values, and report missing parameters.
Former crash and runtime-table-mapping defects remain fixed for unlabeled hints and polymorphic WITH values.

Reading clauses execute left to right across MATCH, OPTIONAL MATCH, UNWIND, name-selected and aliased table-function CALL, and LOAD while preserving scope, NULL extension, source cardinality, and node identity.
Relationship-group physical members retain per-pair identity, reverse routing, and group-wide drop behavior.
ONE_ONE, MANY_ONE, ONE_MANY, and MANY_MANY relationship constraints enforce incoming/outgoing cardinality atomically.
Unlabeled and multi-type relationship patterns route across candidate tables with endpoint narrowing and runtime identity.
RETURN star and WITH star expand only variables currently in scope.
FLOAT, UUID, BLOB, typed columns, and variadic numeric greatest/least preserve values, coercion, NULL, ties, arity, and errors.
Sequence namespaces, bounds, cycling, nextval/currval, serial ownership, explicit transactions, recovery, and drop collisions remain correct.
SERIAL columns allocate independent monotonically increasing defaults when values are omitted.
EXISTS and COUNT subqueries preserve correlation, nesting, result cardinality, and explicit unsupported boundaries.
DATE, TIMESTAMP, and INTERVAL construction, casts, comparison, storage, and ordering remain typed and exact.
TIMESTAMP, NS, MS, SEC, and TZ casts normalize offsets, compare by instant, and render at the declared precision.
OPTIONAL MATCH over a bundled typed graph preserves global NULL rows, correlated chains, predicates, aggregates, and row multiplicity.
Correlated EXISTS and COUNT subqueries over a bundled graph preserve predicate and projection cardinality.
The bundled TinySNB schema loads broad scalar/nested types and supports aggregate, date-filter, and timestamp-order queries.
UNION and UNION ALL over a bundled graph preserve duplicates, DISTINCT, chains, NULLs, columns, and validation diagnostics.
WITH over a bundled graph preserves scalar/aggregate pipelines, cross products, UNWIND composition, node carry, ordering, and limits.
Explicit read-write/read-only transactions preserve visibility, commit, rollback, DDL rollback, nested-BEGIN failure, and invalid completion errors.
Adversarial regressions preserve aggregate widening/type rejection, CREATE coercion, and signed-zero grouping.
UINT128 literals, casts, arithmetic, overflow, absolute value, and cross-integer comparisons preserve full width.
UNION and UNION ALL preserve set/bag semantics, chaining, schema compatibility, and stable binder errors.
UNWIND preserves literal, aggregate, function-produced, nested, NULL, and MATCH-composed list cardinality over a bundled graph.
User-defined aliases compose through primitive, struct, list, nested, alias-of-alias, column, and cast positions with duplicate checks.
Variable-length and recursive paths preserve bounds, direction, modes, shortest variants, path values, and per-step filtering/projection.
WITH preserves scalar, aggregate, node, and relationship values across query parts with ordering, limits, scope, and validation.
